usageNotes: Returns the VM configuration that was captured at snapshot time, including CPU, memory, and disk settings as they existed when the snapshot was taken. Useful for auditing what changed between a snapshot and the current VM config, or verifying a snapshot captured the expected state before rolling back. Requires VM.Snapshot, VM.Snapshot.Rollback, or VM.Audit permission on the VM (any one suffices); the node must be online.

examples.summary: Retrieve the config captured in the 'pre-upgrade' snapshot for VM 105

tips: snapname must follow the pve-configid format (alphanumeric, hyphens allowed, max 40 chars) — use list_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_snapshot to see valid snapshot names for the VM.
The returned object reflects the hardware config at snapshot creation time, not the current VM config; diff it against the live config endpoint to identify drift.
This endpoint has no query parameters; all required values are path parameters.
